mutation.instruction: In S05 replace the retention table cell that names the basis and period for order records with a bare period and no basis.
mutation.defectiveText: 주문 정보: 보관합니다 (기간은 회사 내부 기준에 따릅니다)

rationale: S05 must state the period agreed with the data subject, needed for the contract, or set by law for each item; a period with no basis and no concrete length fails R-S05-001 and R-S05-005.
